This is the re-run of my killed round-7 run; I neither read nor cited its orphaned material (docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa-r7-orphaned/). In this run I wrote only test probes outside the frozen candidate (docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/tests/round-7/), evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/round-7/, and these review files. Every mutant and probe ran in disposable copies under $TMPDIR. I formed my verdict without reading the other reviewers' round-7 records or evidence; the two commits that landed during my run (0dd91fc, 05d2500) carry their auto-committed run evidence, which I did not open.

summary: FAIL, solely because my round-6 finding F-DG4-148 (Low, non-mandatory) does not verify CLOSED, and the assignment allows PASS only if all three do. F-DG4-146 and F-DG4-147 are CLOSED_VERIFIED. F-DG4-146: mutants M4, M4a and M4b are each killed by session-wait.test.tsx. F-DG4-147: the pre-repair spec fails 12/12 with a delayed boot /me, and the repaired one passes 12/12 and 40/40 under contention. F-DG4-148: the split test script and the warm-up are sound and weaken nothing (H1-H5b). But pnpm test still fails at the load the concurrent reviews create: 3 of 4 runs at load 22-30, and 1 of 4 with the load held at 13-16 (median 15.5 during the failing run), in both of the finding's classes: the architecture.test.ts 30 s timeout and the first-render 5 s wait in raid 'action register' (en). It passes 4/4 at low load. The rest of the review is green on candidate sha256:baa6ff4d...: static 7/7; integration 1984/1984 twice (61 migrations, contract.test.ts, 652 operations, 0 pending); tests/qa 172/172; REQ-DLV-036 85/85; both full e2e runs with all 364 tests counted and every timeout passing solo; probes 546+77+14 checks per language with 0 failed (axe, 390 px, 200 %, AUD); validator 5/5; trace 137/137.
